title: Workflow definition
description: One version of a workflow: its graph, the names its runs may store, and the schemas of its run parameters and of its state.

name.description: Name of the workflow. Stored as workflow_name of every run.

version.description: Version of the definition. Stored as workflow_version of every run. A version never changes once published.

description.description: What the workflow does, in one or two sentences.

agent_roles.description: Every agent role, with the version of its prompt. A model is chosen per role.

stages.description: Every stage, in workflow order, as a flat list. The parent of a stage makes the tree.

nodes.description: Every node of the graph, including the start node and the end node.

artifact_kinds.description: Every artifact kind a run may create, with the content schema version it uses.

item_kinds.description: Every item kind a run may create, with the content schema version it uses.

link_types.description: Every trace link type, with the pairs of item kinds it may connect.

value_lists.description: Every named list of allowed values for a content field that names it with x-value-list.

tools.description: Every tool that an agent may use while it works. A note of a step that tells of the use of a tool names one of them, and a client takes its words and its icon from here.

persona_aspects.description: The aspects that every persona is scored on, defined by the system: the first tier. The agent that plans the interviews may propose more for a project: the second tier.

directive_kinds.description: Every directive kind, with its item roles and the schema of its details.

run_parameters_schema.description: JSON Schema of parameters in the run configuration.

state_schema.description: JSON Schema of the workflow state returned by the state endpoints.

name.description: A lower-case name with underscores, for example checkpoint_analysis.

objectSchema.description: A JSON Schema whose instances are objects.

first_run.description: Node at which the first run of a project starts.

later_runs.description: Node at which every later run of a thread starts.

pending_messages.description: Node a run goes to after any node when user messages are pending.

prompt_version.description: Version of the prompt file of the role that runs of this definition use.

title.description: The name of the stage as shown to the user, for example in the status bar and the progress view.

internal.description: True for a stage that is a step of the system and not of the user's work. The client does not show it to the user and keeps the title of the previous stage.

parent.description: The stage this one belongs to, or null for a top-level stage. A stage with children groups them as a tree; it is listed before its children.

title.description: The name of the checkpoint as shown to the user, for example in the list of reviews the user may turn on and in the status bar.

prompt.description: What the user is asked when the run pauses here.

review_artifact_kinds.description: Kinds of the artifacts under review. Their current versions become review_artifacts of the interrupt.

allow_edits.description: Whether the user may edit items of the artifacts under review before answering.

options.description: The decision that chooses where the run continues. Empty when the checkpoint only asks questions.

questions.description: Further questions asked every time, answered together with the option.

agent_questions.description: Whether the agent may add questions at run time, each with a default.

purpose.description: What the user does at this checkpoint. `review`: look at documents and approve them or ask for changes; it holds no question of the agent. `ask`: answer the questions of the agent, with no document under review; the run does not pause when the agent has no question.

asks_before.description: For an `ask` checkpoint: the review checkpoint that follows it. The questions are those that the agent wrote for that review. Without it, the agent writes the questions from the idea of the product.

approves.description: Choosing it sets the artifacts under review, and their items that are still draft, to approved.

is_default.description: Taken without asking when the checkpoint is not in review_checkpoints of the run.

choices.description: At least two for single_select and multi_select; empty for the other types.

min_selected.description: For multi_select only: the fewest choices an answer may pick. Null means no bound.

max_selected.description: For multi_select only: the most choices an answer may pick. Null means no bound.

default_answer.description: The answer taken without asking, valid as an answer to the question. Null only when the question is not required.

choice_keys.description: The keys of the chosen choices; empty for free_text and number.

text.description: The answer of a free_text question, or the explanation of a chosen choice that requires text.

number.description: The answer of a number question.

requires_text.description: Choosing it asks the user to explain it in text, for example an Other choice. Never a default.

label.description: The condition as shown on the graph.

conditional.description: True when the edge is taken only under a condition.

option.description: The checkpoint option that leads along the edge.

stage.description: The stage that produces it. Artifacts are listed in the order of these stages.

per_project.description: How many artifacts of the kind a project may have. one_per_subject means one per subject item.

subject_item_kind.description: Kind of the subject item, when per_project is one_per_subject.

item_kinds.description: Item kinds an artifact of this kind contains. Empty for an artifact with no items.

issue.description: Set for a kind of item that records a problem to settle: where its content says whether it is still open. Null for any other kind.

status_field.description: The field of the content that holds the status of the issue.

open_values.description: The values of that field while the issue is still open.

about_link_types.description: The keys of the link types that tie an issue of the kind to the items it is about.

party_link_types.description: The keys of the link types that tie an issue of the kind to the people it involves.

acyclic.description: Following links of this type from an item must never return to it.

agent_only.description: Whether only the agents create links of this type during a run; the user never creates one by hand.

quotes.description: Which item of a link of this type may be quoted: words of the source (source_quote), words of the target (target_quote). A quote is optional where it is allowed.

source.description: Item kinds allowed as source, or any for every item kind except section.

target.description: Item kinds allowed as target, any for every item kind except section, or same for the kind of the source.

description.description: What the aspect measures, in one sentence.

title.description: What the tool is, in a few words.

other.description: The line for the uses of the tool that follow one another in a step. `{count}` stands for their number.

icon.description: The mark of the tool in a client, from a fixed set that a client draws.

description.description: What the value means. Shown in the client and given to agents in their prompts.

item_roles.description: The roles an item can have in a directive of this kind.

details_schema.description: JSON Schema of details of a directive of this kind.

artifact_kinds.description: Kinds of the artifacts the document is built from.
